title: Synthetic Eggs in Many Baskets: The Impact of Synthetic Data Diversity on LLM Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models in an LLM-as-a-judge setting using pairwise ranking and direct assessment to measure whether a fine-tuned model prefers its own generated summaries over those generated by other models.
Comparing judge models' preference scores for synthetic, model-generated text versus human-written text in pairwise ranking and absolute assessment tasks.
